title: ShoppingListDetailView: core structure
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListDetailView.swift` with the core detail view: navigation title set to the list display name, a "X of Y items checked" progress header (`.subheadline`, `.secondary`, hidden when list is empty), aisle-grouped sections produced by `ShoppingListAisleGrouper` each rendered with an `AisleIconMap`-derived SF Symbol, the aisle name ("Other" for nil-named bucket), a badge count, and a collapsible disclosure (in-memory per-section collapse state, not persisted across launches). Each item in a section is rendered with `ShoppingListItemRow`. Empty-list empty state: `cart` icon, "Empty list", "Tap + to add an item.".
acceptance_criteria: Navigation title equals the list's display name
"X of Y items checked" header is visible and recomputes after each toggle
Header is hidden when the list has zero items
Sections are in the order returned by ShoppingListAisleGrouper
Each section header shows the correct AisleIconMap SF Symbol, aisle name, and item count badge
Sections are collapsible; collapse state persists across re-renders of the same view instance but not across app launches
Empty-list empty state renders correctly (cart icon, correct title and subtitle)

handoff_summary.completed: Created CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListDetailView.swift replacing the stub. Key design choices: @State list loaded from disk in .task; @State collapsedSections: Set<String> for in-memory per-section collapse (not persisted); ShoppingListAisleGrouper groups filtered to non-empty; nil-named group displayed as "Other"; AisleIconMap.symbol(for:) drives SF Symbol per section header; private AisleSectionHeader view with chevron toggle; progress header always visible when totalCount > 0 (guarded by the else-if in body); all mutations (toggle/delete/update) write back to disk via ShoppingListFiles.writeText; AddItemSheet wired via @State showAddSheet sheet. Build verified: BUILD SUCCEEDED.
handoff_summary.remaining: None — all acceptance criteria satisfied and build passes.
handoff_summary.risks: Nil — no regressions introduced. Collapse state keyed by section name means two sections with identical names would share collapse state, but the grouper produces at most one nil group and aisle names are expected to be unique in practice.
handoff_summary.next_action: Route to tester agent for UI and acceptance criteria validation.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. Only ShoppingListDetailView.swift was modified; no shared utilities or models were touched.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: 1) Used @State collapsedSections: Set<String> (nil-group key = "Other") for transient collapse state — no UserDefaults/persistence per spec. 2) Progress header rendered inside a .listRowBackground(Color.clear) Section so it blends with the List style rather than floating above it. 3) AisleSectionHeader is a private fileprivate struct rather than inline ViewBuilder to keep the ForEach closure readable. 4) Save-to-disk is fire-and-forget (try?) — file write errors are silently dropped consistent with the rest of the codebase pattern in ShoppingListsView. 5) Catalog loaded from url.deletingLastPathComponent() to find the aisle.conf alongside the markdown file.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written — tester agent responsibility. Key scenarios to cover: toggle recomputes progress header, collapse persists across re-renders but not relaunches, empty list shows EmptyStateView, header hidden when totalCount == 0, AisleIconMap symbol appears in section header.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Collapse state keyed by section display name — two sections with identical names (unlikely in practice) would share collapse state. No error UI if file write fails.

conflict_risks: None. Only ShoppingListDetailView.swift was modified; no shared utilities or models were touched.

execution_history.summary: Implemented ShoppingListDetailView with all required acceptance criteria: navigation title from file name, progress header ("X of Y items checked"), aisle-grouped collapsible sections with SF symbols and badge counts, ShoppingListItemRow per item, empty-state view, and + toolbar button wired to AddItemSheet.
